A '''member''' of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] worked as an informant for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence agency, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] captured the informant and arranged for the individual to be delivered to the Cartel.<ref name="Silencing the Snitch">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Silencing the Snitch}}</ref>
